edge-cases.txt       written for this package: Python's Unicode whitespace (U+0085, U+00A0, U+1680,
                     U+2000..200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+202F, U+205F, U+3000, U+001C..001F, VT, FF, CRLF),
                     U+200B and U+FEFF (not whitespace), non-ASCII letters, ' and - inside and around
                     words, -le/-ee/silent-e words, runs of stops, no final newline
short.txt            under 30 words: ease none
empty.txt            no words, no sentences: ease none
no-stop.txt          32 words and no sentence stop: one sentence

The corpus files are UTF-8; Unicode whitespace is handled exactly, not just ASCII whitespace.
